PHYSICAL EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Shot put: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Shot put.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Shot put.
   C. Damage equipment used for Shot put.
   D. Practise Shot put with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   C. Practise Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.

6. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   D. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

8. Best practice when working on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   B. Replace drinking water
